verdict.rationale: Activepieces' AI agents can be described in natural language to perform tasks like 'summarise my unread emails every morning', which shows agents can generate summaries/insights from connected data sources, but there's no dedicated analytics/insights dashboard or proactive suggestion feature surfaced inside the product itself. missing for 10: no evidence of a built-in analytics/insights UI, no proactive suggestion engine surfacing patterns from user data, no independent corroboration of AI-generated insights beyond the changelog example.
